plugins.description: Companion plugin for the copier-pyproject Copier template. Ships three skills: `adopt` (first-time adoption into an existing/published Python package), `update` (later `copier update` runs and Renovate copier-update PRs), and `setup` (one-time repository + release-automation wiring).
